description: For every primitive-recursive presentation \(p\) and ordinary input \(\bar a\), PA derives \(\forall y\,(F_p(\overline{\bar a},y)\leftrightarrow y=\overline{p(\bar a)})\) for the chosen normalized graph \(F_p\).
